reference_kind: Supplementary 2024 regression intervals adapted from reported references; not ISO-issued 2024 acceptance values
derivation: Reported midpoint + independent full-2024 level minus independent level with pre-2024 ground/Dz/Kmet equations; original interval half-width retained
baseline_scope: Published scene geometry with latest supported path selection and 2024 aperture held fixed; baseline is a diagnostic mixture, not a 1996 solver
limitations: T09/T19 correction intervals are vendor-reported; the original working-group correction document has not been obtained
Latest T19 band selection is independently corroborated by Theers et al., DAGA 2026, p. 722
T14 elevation conventions and T18 terminal courtyard construction retain the documented scene interpretations
Equation effects are sequential and interact through clipping and energy summation; only their total is order-independent

reported_reference_source.title: Wölfel IMMI 2025 declaration of conformity according to ISO/TR 17534-3:2015
reported_reference_source.correction_provenance: PDF page 4 cites ISO TC43 SC1 WG 56 corrections from October 2020; the working-group correction document itself has not been obtained
reported_reference_source.transcription: Midpoints and limits of the printed certified-result columns, visually checked on PDF pages 7 and 10; software-result and yes/no columns are not reference data
caveats: The vendor software-result column gives 11.01 dB outside its own printed 13.63-13.73 dB interval for T06/T19 at 63 Hz. Those results and yes/no assertions are not adopted.
These reported corrections supplement the unchanged original fixture. They do not establish 2024 conformity or certify the current engine.
